title: Immediate early response 3 promotes airway epithelial inflammation and represents a therapeutic target in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
authors: Yang, Yuanlan; Hu, Zhengyu; Wang, Wenjing; Wu, Mindan; Cui, Yachao; Chen, Zemin; Jin, Xuan; Huang, Wenfeng; Yan, Jiawei; Zhang, Feng; Yin, Wenguang; Cui, Jieda; Zhu, Leqing; Ran, Pixin; Dai, Jianwei
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦COPD中IER3介导的气道上皮炎症机制与治疗靶点，核心为疾病表型与炎症通路，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is characterized by persistent airway inflammation, yet clinically useful biomarkers and mechanistically validated therapeutic targets remain limited. Here, we aimed to identify and functionally validate smoke-responsive regulators of airway epithelial inflammation in COPD and establish an interpretable prediction framework by integrating population-based clinical data, multi-omics analyses, genetic causal inference, and experimental validation. METHODS: Complementary clinical and molecular investigations used separate populations. Interpretable machine-learning models classified recorded COPD status in CHARLS, with validation across survey waves. Independent lung transcriptomic analyses integrated differential expression, co-expression networks, 113 machine-learning configurations, and single-cell profiling. Two-sample Mendelian randomization examined genetically predicted IER3 expression in relation to FEV(1)/FVC. Functional effects of IER3 were evaluated through AAV-mediated silencing in cigarette-smoke-exposed mice and siRNA knockdown in cigarette-smoke-extract-stimulated bronchial epithelial cells. Drug screening and molecular simulations prioritized candidate compounds for further investigation. RESULTS: The support vector machine achieved the best predictive performance for COPD risk (test AUC = 0.821; temporal validation AUC = 0.829). Multi-omics analyses consistently identified IER3 as a central COPD-associated gene within an inflammation-enriched transcriptional network. A six-gene diagnostic signature demonstrated robust external performance (AUC = 0.882 and 0.836), with IER3 and ATF3 emerging as the most reproducible biomarkers across independent cohorts. Single-cell analysis localized IER3 predominantly to airway epithelial cells and macrophages and revealed enhanced epithelial-macrophage communication in COPD. Mendelian randomization supported a causal association between genetically predicted IER3 expression and impaired lung function (IVW beta = -0.042, P < 0.001). Experimental studies further demonstrated that cigarette smoke induced epithelial IER3 expression, whereas IER3 silencing suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokine production, reduced inflammatory-cell recruitment, alleviated lung injury, and partially restored pulmonary function. Drug-repurposing analysis nominated IMD-0354 as a potential candidate modulator of the IER3-associated inflammatory axis. CONCLUSIONS: We developed an interpretable machine-learning framework for COPD risk prediction and identified IER3 as a candidate mediator of airway epithelial inflammation. Integrated evidence supports its involvement in smoke-induced inflammatory amplification and potential contribution to impaired lung function, highlighting IER3 as a potential therapeutic target warranting further mechanistic and clinical validation.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）以持续性气道炎症为特征，但临床上有用的生物标志物和经机制验证的治疗靶点仍然有限。本研究旨在通过整合基于人群的临床数据、多组学分析、遗传因果推断和实验验证，识别并功能验证COPD中烟雾反应性气道上皮炎症的调控因子，并建立可解释的预测框架。方法：互补的临床和分子研究使用了独立人群。可解释的机器学习模型对CHARLS中记录的COPD状态进行分类，并在各调查轮次中进行验证。独立的肺组织转录组分析整合了差异表达、共表达网络、113种机器学习配置和单细胞分析。双样本孟德尔随机化检验了遗传预测的IER3表达与FEV(1)/FVC之间的关系。通过香烟烟雾暴露小鼠中的AAV介导沉默和香烟烟雾提取物刺激的支气管上皮细胞中的siRNA敲低，评估了IER3的功能效应。药物筛选和分子模拟优先考虑了候选化合物以供进一步研究。结果：支持向量机在COPD风险预测中达到最佳性能（测试AUC = 0.821；时间验证AUC = 0.829）。多组学分析一致地将IER3识别为炎症富集转录网络中的核心COPD相关基因。六基因诊断特征在外部验证中表现出稳健性能（AUC = 0.882和0.836），其中IER3和ATF3在独立队列中成为最可重复的生物标志物。单细胞分析将IER3主要定位于气道上皮细胞和巨噬细胞，并揭示COPD中上皮-巨噬细胞通讯增强。孟德尔随机化支持遗传预测的IER3表达与肺功能受损之间的因果关联（IVW beta = -0.042，P < 0.001）。实验研究进一步表明，香烟烟雾诱导上皮IER3表达，而IER3沉默抑制促炎细胞因子产生、减少炎症细胞募集、减轻肺损伤并部分恢复肺功能。药物重定位分析提名IMD-0354为IER3相关炎症轴的潜在候选调节剂。结论：我们开发了用于COPD风险预测的可解释机器学习框架，并将IER3识别为气道上皮炎症的候选介质。综合证据支持其参与烟雾诱导的炎症放大及其对肺功能受损的潜在贡献，突出IER3作为潜在治疗靶点，值得进一步的机制和临床验证。
